recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a deep red-to-black gradient sky with a stark black silhouette of a landscape and a lone figure in the foreground, topped with elegant, classical serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy from top-aligned text to bottom-aligned silhouette
Color contrast between the vibrant red sky and the absolute black foreground
Scale contrast between the small, detailed silhouette and the vast, empty sky
coreInvariants: Deep crimson to dark maroon sky gradient
Solid black horizon line and silhouettes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A lone human silhouette stands on the right third of the frame; a neoclassical building silhouette sits on the far left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, centered title text in the upper third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright title, moves down through the red void, and settles on the sharp silhouette details at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the center, occupied only by the color gradient.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones of the sky, transitioning to low value (black) at the top and bottom edges.

letterConstructionRules: Small caps used for secondary information
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial capitals for the main title words
Thin horizontal rule underlining the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using varying scales and small caps for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions with a cinematic feel.
Standard for cinematic drama and historical themes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dramatic landscape at dusk. The sky is a deep crimson to dark maroon gradient. The foreground is a solid black silhouette featuring a neoclassical building with columns on the left and a lone man standing on the right. The horizon is a flat black line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text in the upper third using a gold-colored classical serif font. Use all caps with wide tracking. Place a thin horizontal line under the main title. Add smaller metadata text at the very top and very bottom in the same font family.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a smooth red-to-black gradient?
Are the foreground elements pure black silhouettes?
Is the typography centered and elegant?
Is there a thin horizontal rule under the main title?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the silhouette
Specific names of actors or creators

mustAchieve: Smooth color banding in the gradient

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette is solid black with no internal detail.
Check that the gold text is legible against the red background.
Verify the neoclassical building and figure are positioned on opposite sides.
Confirm the use of a thin horizontal divider line.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dramatic two-tone color gradient sky with a stark black silhouette landscape and centered, wide-tracked classical serif typography for a historical cinematic aesthetic.
